description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This release keeps tasks running while agents finish background work, makes configuration sync safer and adds appearance settings to it, adds Claude Code cache mode settings, reduces memory retained after closing conversations, and updates several agents.
New
- Tasks and automation runs now wait for background work to finish. Previously a run could end, and its background commands or sub-agents be cut off, as soon as the agent's reply finished. Now the run stays open until that work completes and the agent's follow-up reply arrives, and that reply becomes the run's summary. The task card shows how many background jobs are still running and offers a "Stop waiting" action.
- Configuration sync now includes appearance settings: light/dark mode, theme color, zoom, fonts, background display and custom styles.
- New Cache mode settings in the Claude Code config panel, with switches for the one-hour prompt cache of the main conversation and of sub-agents.
Improved
- Updated Claude Code (claude-agent-acp 0.107.0) and OpenCode to 2.3.0, DeepSeek to 0.11.0, Cursor to 2026.11.13, Kimi Code to 2.6.2, Qoder to 1.1.89, ZCode to 0.85.2 and Command Code to 1.89.1. The DeepSeek settings follow the new version's setup: it uses the Anthropic-compatible endpoint by default and requires Node.js 22.19.0 or later.
Fixed
- Configuration sync no longer overwrites settings uploaded from another machine. Fresh installs and machines that have not synced in a while no longer replace a newer remote snapshot. Instead, you can see where the snapshot came from and choose to restore it or replace it. Opening codeg in a new browser also no longer resets the server's appearance settings. (#1149, reported by @zinsser901224)
- Reduced memory retained after closing a conversation that showed a streamed reply. (#1157 by @kogekiplay)
- Connected agent sessions are no longer shown as "connecting". (#1152 by @kogekiplay)
Thanks to @kogekiplay for contributing to this release, and to @zinsser901224 for reporting the sync issue.
